name: watchdog
description: A quiet background reviewer that reads each turn and raises severity-tagged notes to the main session.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Review turns in new sessions. Each review is a model call billed to you. /watchdog on|off overrides it for a session.

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: An alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

reviewInterval.title: Review interval
reviewInterval.description: Review every Nth answered turn; skipped turns are folded into the next review.

continueSeverity.title: Wake at severity
continueSeverity.description: Lowest note severity that wakes a finished turn. Nits never wake.

immuneTurns.title: Cooldown turns
immuneTurns.description: After a wake, how many main turns concerns can't wake again. Blockers are exempt.

maxNotes.title: Notes per review
maxNotes.description: Nits and concerns admitted per review (1-32). Blockers aren't capped.

maxDeltaChars.title: Evidence characters
maxDeltaChars.description: Characters of turn evidence sent per review (2000-200000).

timeoutSeconds.title: Review timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one review may take before it is abandoned as incomplete (10-600).

reviewHeadless.title: Review headless sessions
reviewHeadless.description: Also review in claude -p and SDK sessions, before the process exits. There is no wake there.
